material.name: paper
material.label: Matte paper
material.character: Low-amplitude crossed fibers, broad diffuse shading, restrained edge lift.

descriptors.calibration: authored material parameters; GPU Lambert/GGX response and CSS fallback are distinct rendering paths, neither is a measured material classification or preference score

contrast.requirement: Capture actual background behind text across lighting, motion and backdrop states; nominal swatches do not certify rendered contrast.

limits: The optional WebGL plane evaluates Lambert/GGX/Schlick/separable Smith, matching the headless probe conventions. Authored ambient fill, normal maps and tone mapping are explicit approximations; no energy-conservation claim.
CSS gradients, alpha layers and shadows approximate a lit 2D surface. They are not an energy-conserving BRDF, radiometry, occlusion solver or real refraction.
Roughness broadens an authored highlight; it is not a measured microfacet distribution. Brushed grooves are a directional visual cue, not anisotropic PBR.
Backdrop filtering depends on ancestor compositing and browser behavior. Solid-color fallback remains available.
No universal material-pair or beauty score is produced. Verify readability and motion on target devices.
